name: get_agent_state
summary: Get the status of the user's Raily matching agent, such as not started, active or paused.

name: get_agent_door
summary: Get the user's public agent door link, which other people can use to ask the user's agent for an introduction.

name: get_brief
summary: Get the user's current Brief: who they are looking for, what they offer, their deal-breakers and style.

name: list_match_deliveries
summary: List the match cards waiting for the user's decision. Only reads; it does not open or use up a card.

name: list_connection_requests
summary: List contact requests other people sent the user, with counts. Personal details are limited for privacy.

name: get_negotiation_report
summary: Get the saved negotiation report about the user and one connected person (other_id). Does not create a new report.

name: get_subscription
summary: Get the user's plan, included match budget and renewal date.

name: get_agent_report_latest
summary: Get the most recent report the agent prepared for the user, whether queued or already sent.

name: get_agent_settings
summary: Get the user's language, matching settings (privacy, area, intent, city, timezone) and report schedule.

name: list_match_history
summary: List the user's past match events, one page at a time. Profile text written by other people is untrusted.

name: list_agent_checks
summary: List the checks the agent has completed for the user, one page at a time, with its current status flags.

name: get_memory_timeline
summary: List what the agent has learned about the user's preferences over time, one page at a time.

name: get_bar_state
summary: Get the user's match bar (minimum match score), vetoed and prioritized intents, and Brief version.

name: get_focus
summary: Get the user's current focus, a short-term matching priority, plus the basis_token and revision set_focus needs.

name: get_memory_export
summary: Export everything the agent remembers about the user, one page at a time. Only reads.

name: request_analysis_link
summary: Create a one-time link, valid for 1 hour, that opens photo analysis on railyai.com for the user (self) or another person (other). Each call creates a new link.

name: get_analysis_status
summary: Get the status of one of the user's photo analyses by its task_id.

name: get_analysis_handoff_status
summary: Check the progress of a photo analysis started with modern_request_analysis_link, by its analysis_request_id.

name: get_brief_question
summary: Get the next question of the user's Brief interview. With start_new_brief=true, operation_key and expected_brief_version it restarts the interview from the first question; the saved Brief stays. A restart may need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: open_delivery
summary: Open one match card to see who the match is.

name: skip_delivery
summary: Skip one match card the user does not want.

name: record_skip_feedback
summary: Tell the agent why the user skipped a match card, to improve later matches. reason: not_my_intent, too_far, wrong_vibe, busy_now, not_enough_shown or other; note is optional. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: refill_free_batch
summary: Refill the user's free batch of match cards. Pass the current batch id as expected_batch_id. Costs nothing.

name: request_contact
summary: Send a contact request to a match; set open_intro=true to include an intro message. The other person is notified. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: accept_private_contact
summary: Accept a contact request someone sent the user. The other person is notified. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: reply_to_open_contact
summary: Reply to the intro message someone sent the user with their contact request. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: dismiss_contact
summary: Decline a contact request someone sent the user. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: end_connection
summary: End the user's connection with one person. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: suggest_brief_answers
summary: Suggest possible answers for one Brief field, based on what Raily knows about the user. The Brief is not changed.

name: answer_brief_question
summary: Save the user's answer to the current Brief interview question. Needs the question_token from get_brief_question. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: answer_debrief
summary: Tell the agent how contact with a match went, to improve later matches. quality: worth_again, neutral, not_a_fit or too_early; meet_kind: met, scheduled, online_only or no_plan. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: edit_brief_instruction
summary: Change one saved Brief answer. Pass the current value and versions so an outdated edit is refused; retain_focus=true keeps the current focus. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: set_focus
summary: Set a short-term matching focus for a week or until removed. Needs the basis_token and revision from get_focus. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: revoke_focus
summary: Remove the user's current focus so matching follows the Brief alone. Works even while the focus feature is switched off.

name: reset_memory
summary: Reset what the agent learned from feedback: the match bar returns to its default and vetoed and prioritized intents are cleared. Brief answers are kept. expected_state takes the current values from get_bar_state. Always needs the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: launch_agent
summary: Start the user's matching agent in a home city, given as a GeoNames city id. Fails if the user's setup on railyai.com is incomplete. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: knock_agent_door
summary: Ask another person's agent for an introduction through their public door handle. Free; costs no credits. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: buy_paid_batch
summary: Buy one batch of 10 extra match cards for 1 Raily credit. Always needs the owner's approval on railyai.com; never charges a card.

name: reserve_agent_budget_batch
summary: Take the next batch of 10 match cards from the budget included in the user's plan. No extra charge.

name: request_balance_topup_link
summary: Create a railyai.com link where the owner can buy Raily credits (single, pack3 or pack5). This tool never charges.

name: modern_request_analysis_link
summary: Create a link, valid for 1 hour, to run photo analysis on railyai.com for the user (self) or another person (other).

name: act_on_negotiation_report
summary: Act on a negotiation report: accept the match, decline it, or ask (returns a link to ask the agent). Declining ends the connection and takes an optional reason and note. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: send_match_message
summary: Send a message to a person the user is connected with. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: update_self_settings
summary: Change the user's language: en, ru, es, pt-BR or ar.

name: update_matching_settings
summary: Change matching settings: privacy mode, search area, main intent, home city (GeoNames id) or timezone. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: pause_matching
summary: Pause the agent so it stops looking for new matches. The focus is kept. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.

name: resume_matching
summary: Resume a paused agent. The focus is kept. May need the owner's approval on railyai.com.
